newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Gillette trades higher at 83.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Gillette trades higher at 83.

text.p: Gillette Co was trading at 83 against a close on the New York Stock Exchange of 81-1/2 in a mild after-hours session, traders said Friday.
"It's not so active," said one of them. "There's been between 4,000 and 5,000 shares traded (in the company)."
Gillette reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.21 a share after charges, compared to $0.64 for the same period a year ago.
"A couple of people are offering to sell (shares in the company)," the trader said.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 75,000 shares compared to Thursday's 9,000, while session two had 3,739,200 shares against 3,970,486.
